feature: Recruiting batch resume intake and guarded human review

flows.name: Batch intake, replay, assignment, and disposition
steps: Authenticate as an authorized recruiting user
Upload two approved synthetic resumes as one batch
Replay the same batch key after simulated response loss
Open an original resume through the inline signed viewer
Assign an unassigned candidate to an open UAT requisition
Mark the application Not Qualified with a required reason
Clean up all synthetic candidates and storage objects
flows.expectedOutcome: Each file has a visible result, replay is exact and repairs missing storage without consuming more rate attempts, the resume opens inline, assignment occurs once, Not Qualified is audited through the guarded RPC, and cleanup leaves no final-run records.

checks: Per-file batch results and the unassigned inbox are readable
Assignment and original-resume controls are usable
The Not Qualified outcome is visibly confirmed
The mobile route has no document-level horizontal overflow

claims.description: Two approved resumes upload together with visible per-file results and unassigned candidates.
A response-loss replay returns the same records, consumes no additional rate attempts, and restores a missing storage object.
An authorized recruiter opens the original resume inline and assigns the unassigned candidate once.
Direct outcome writes fail and the guarded disposition RPC records a human Not Qualified decision with a reason.
Desktop and mobile evidence shows a usable recruiting workflow without document overflow.
Synthetic records are cleaned and no stale app-admin recruiting-role snapshots remain.
